name: Department of Bangla
about: The department traces its roots to Jagannath College, where Honours and Master's courses in Bangla began in the 1972-73 session. It now also runs MPhil and PhD programmes and a Master of Arts in Functional Bengali Language and Literature.

name: Department of English
about: BA (Honours) and MA in English have been offered here since 1910, from the Jagannath College era. The department offers an MA with ELT & Applied Linguistics and Literature & Cultural Studies streams, a Professional MA, and MPhil and PhD programmes.

name: Department of History
about: The department was established in 1975 under Jagannath College and became part of Jagannath University in 2005. It offers a four-year BA (Honours), an MA, and MPhil and PhD programmes, taught in English since 2017.

name: Department of Islamic History & Culture
about: The Department of Islamic History and Culture was established with the university in 2005; its BA and MA courses date back to 1972 at Jagannath College. It offers BA (Honours), MA in three groups, and MPhil and PhD programmes.

name: Department of Islamic Studies
about: The department offers a four-year BA (Honours), a one-year MA, a two-year MA (Professional), and MPhil and PhD programmes in Islamic Studies.

name: Department of Philosophy
about: The department offers a four-year Bachelor (Honours) and a Master of Arts in Philosophy.

name: Department of Music
about: The department began in the 2013-14 session as the Drama and Music Department and became a separate Department of Music in January 2016. It runs a four-year BA (Honours) with Classical, Rabindra Sangeet and Nazrul Sangeet branches.

name: Department of Accounting & Information System
about: Formerly the Department of Accounting, the department has run its own curriculum since 2005. It offers a BBA, an MBA (regular and professional), and MPhil and PhD programmes in Accounting.

name: Department of Management Studies
about: The department offers BBA, MBA, MBA (Professional), MPhil and PhD programmes, with around 1,500 students enrolled.

name: Department of Finance
about: The department was established in the 2006-07 session with a single BBA batch. It trains graduates in finance, banking and insurance through a 132-credit BBA including an internship, along with an MBA.

name: Department of Marketing
about: The department offers BBA, MBA and EMBA programmes in marketing, with internship programmes and job fair access for students.

name: Department of Chemistry
about: The department offers a four-year BSc (Honours), a one-year MSc, and MPhil and PhD programmes in Chemistry, with 28 faculty members.

name: Department of Mathematics
about: The department started its own curriculum in 2005 and offers BSc (Honours), MSc, MPhil and PhD degrees in Mathematics.

name: Department of Physics
about: The department offers a four-year BSc (Honours), an MSc, an MSc in Applied Physics and Electronics (Professional), and MPhil and PhD programmes. Research areas include solid-state, nuclear, materials, nano-materials and renewable-energy physics.

name: Department of Statistics
about: The department began in 1964 under Jagannath College and introduced BSc (Honours) in 1973. It now runs a four-year BSc (Honours), a one-year MSc, and MPhil and PhD programmes.

name: Department of Computer Science & Engineering
about: The department started academic activities in 2009. It offers a four-year BSc in CSE, an MSc and an MSc (Professional), with research in AI, databases, data mining, network security and machine learning.

name: Department of Economics
about: First established in 1972 at the erstwhile Jagannath College, the department offers a four-year BSS (Honours) in Economics, an MSS, a professional master's and a PhD programme.

name: Department of Political Science
about: One of the oldest subjects taught at Jagannath College, Political Science became a separate department after the 2005 University Act. It offers a four-year Bachelor, a one-year Master's, and MPhil and PhD programmes.

name: Department of Sociology
about: One of the university's pioneering departments, it has admitted students to four-year Honours and one-year Master's programmes since 2005-06, and launched MPhil and PhD programmes in 2015.

name: Department of Social Work
about: The department offers undergraduate (BSS), graduate (MSS), MPhil and PhD programmes. It trains social work professionals and studies the socio-economic factors that affect individuals, groups and communities.

name: Department of Anthropology
about: The department trains undergraduate and postgraduate students in human biological and cultural diversity using ethnographic methods. It offers BSS, MSS, MPhil and PhD programmes.

name: Department of Mass Communication and Journalism
about: The department started as a four-year Honours programme under the Faculty of Social Science on 4 March 2009. A Master's programme was launched in June 2013; it now offers BSS and MSS programmes.

name: Department of Public Administration
about: The department was inaugurated under the Faculty of Social Science in the 2013-14 academic year. It offers Bachelor (BSS) and Master (MSS) programmes in public administration.

name: Department of Film and Television
about: The department started in 2015 and teaches film and television through a combination of theory and practical work, covering production and research.

name: Department of Law
about: The Department of Law was established in 2008. It offers a four-year LLB (Honours), a one-year LLM and an LLM (Evening) programme, and introduced MPhil and PhD programmes in 2012.

name: Department of Law and Land Administration
about: The Department of Law and Land Administration began in 2016 and focuses on land law and land management alongside core legal courses. It offers LLB (Honours), LLM, MPhil and PhD programmes.

name: Department of Botany
faculty: Faculty of Life and Earth Sciences
about: The department has existed since the establishment of the university, with a focus on plant science. Its areas include crop improvement, conservation of plant and natural resources, and aquatic flora and climate issues.

name: Department of Geography & Environment
faculty: Faculty of Life and Earth Sciences
about: One of the oldest departments at Jagannath, Geography was first taught at degree level in 1953-54 and became the Department of Geography and Environment in 2002. It offers BSc, MSc, MPhil and PhD programmes.

name: Department of Psychology
faculty: Faculty of Life and Earth Sciences
about: The department was established in 1966 at the former Jagannath College with a two-year BSc (Pass) programme. It now runs a four-year BSc (Honours), MSc programmes in three specialisations, and MPhil and PhD programmes.

name: Department of Zoology
faculty: Faculty of Life and Earth Sciences
about: Zoology became a full-fledged department in 1963 after being taught as part of Biology. It offers BSc (Honours), MSc, MPhil and PhD programmes, with MSc specialisations in Entomology, Fisheries, and Wildlife and Biodiversity Conservation.

name: Department of Microbiology
faculty: Faculty of Life and Earth Sciences
about: The department was established in the 2009-10 academic session. It offers a four-year BSc (Honours), a one-year MSc and a two-year MPhil programme.

name: Department of Pharmacy
faculty: Faculty of Life and Earth Sciences
about: The Department of Pharmacy was introduced in 2008 to train pharmaceutical scientists for industry, research and healthcare. It offers B.Pharm (Honours), M.Pharm, M.Pharm (Professional), MPhil and PhD programmes.

name: Department of Biochemistry & Molecular Biology
faculty: Faculty of Life and Earth Sciences
about: The department teaches and researches biochemistry and molecular biology. It admits 30 students a year to a four-year BSc programme and also offers a one-year MSc programme.

name: Department of Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology
faculty: Faculty of Life and Earth Sciences
about: The Department of Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology was established in 2016. It offers a four-year BSc (Honours) programme and a one-year MSc programme.

name: Institute of Education & Research
about: The Institute of Education and Research began in 2016 with the Bachelor of Education (Honours) programme. It offers BEd (Honours), MEd, Professional BEd and MEd, MPhil and PhD programmes.

name: Institute of Modern Languages
about: The Institute of Modern Languages was established in 2015 with its own Board of Governors. It offers a BA (Honours) in English Language and an MA in English Language Teaching.
